grammar_focus: 虚拟 were to do(If you were to ask …, he would …)+ would 表过去反复的习惯、On + 动名词(一…就…)、固定搭配 come into the possession of / cure sb of / put out / out of stock / keep a straight face、consider/find it + 名词/形容词 + to do、被动不定式 to be told / to be surprised + 过去分词短语作状语(原创承载 NCE3 第三册 L52 考点·无需净化:幽默故事——堂兄哈里到化妆品店索要子虚乌有的商品捉弄店员,某次索要“香水泥”竟真有货、破费买下,反被治好了这个恶作剧习惯;美式化 store/salesclerk/dollars/downtown/grayish)
scene: 我的堂兄哈里在他的书房里,一直摆着一只形状古怪的大瓶子。尽管瓶子被染成一种淡雅的绿色,细心的客人很快就会发现,里面装的是一种看上去黏稠、颜色发灰的东西。要是你问哈里瓶里装着什么,他会告诉你是“香水泥”。如果你表示怀疑或惊讶,他会立刻请你闻一闻,然后取出一些抹在你的皮肤上。这个简短的试验会消除你可能还有的一切疑虑——瓶里装的确实是香水泥。哈里是如何得到这种稀奇古怪的东西的,这里头有个有趣的故事,而他也很爱讲给别人听。此外,得到这瓶东西,还治好了他多年来渐渐养成的一个坏习惯。哈里过去总把走进高档化妆品店、一本正经地索要根本不存在的商品当成一大乐事。他会当场编出一些稀奇古怪的货名。一进店,他就会索要一种名叫“香影”的新香水,或者什么“不溶浴皂”。要是女店员告诉他从没听说过,他就会装出十分懊恼、不快的样子。他最爱听人说他那些子虚乌有的产品“暂时脱销”,于是他就煞有介事地保证改天再来光顾——当然,他从没来过。哈里在这些表演中是怎么绷住不笑的,我实在想象不出。要哈里讲他是怎么买下那瓶珍贵香水泥的,根本不用别人催。一天,他走进市中心一家高档商店,索要一种叫“密诺莱特”的东西。女店员一脸茫然,哈里便把这个词又慢慢地、一字一顿地说了一遍。见那女子困惑地摇头,哈里进一步解释说,“密诺莱特”是一种质地坚硬、状似琥珀的东西,可以用来去除雀斑。这番解释显然让那女子听懂了点什么,她一个货架接一个货架地找,拿出各种稀奇古怪的调制品,可没有一样符合哈里的要求。哈里装出略带不快的样子时,店员答应替他订货。被自己的“成功”冲昏了头,哈里又索要起香水泥来。他本以为店员会一脸茫然地望着他,不料这回轮到他自己吃惊了——那女子两眼立刻一亮,取出好几个瓶子摆到柜台上让哈里查看。这一回,哈里不得不认输。他拿起看上去最小的一瓶,谨慎地问了价钱。仅花二十美元就脱了身,他很高兴,便夹着那只珍贵的瓶子匆匆撤退。从那以后,哈里认定他发明的这个小把戏可能代价不菲。那只如今装点着他书房书柜的古怪瓶子,成了他头一回、也是最后一回购买稀有化妆品。

grammar_card.title: were to do / On + 动名词 / cure sb of·keep a straight face / consider it…to do / 被动不定式
grammar_card.intro: ①虚拟对将来的假设:If + 主语 + were to do …, 主语 + would do …:If you were to ask …, he would tell you。②would 也可表过去反复的习惯:He would invent names。③On + 动名词,“一…就…”:On entering a store, he would ask …。④固定搭配:come into the possession of(占有)、cure sb of sth(治好)、put out(不快)、out of stock(脱销)、keep a straight face(板着脸)。⑤consider/find/think it + 名词/形容词 + to do(it 是形式词,真正内容是后面的不定式)。⑥被动不定式 to be told / to be surprised;过去分词短语作状语 Intoxicated by …。

rows: If … were to do, … would do
If you were to ask, he would tell you
On entering a store, he would ask …
cure sb of / out of stock
cured him of a bad habit
consider it + 名词 + to do
considered it a joke to fool clerks

specialRules.rule: were to do 用于对将来不太可能情况的假设,主句用 would/could/might + 动词原形;be 动词一律用 were。
On + 动名词 = as soon as …,“一…就…”;不用 In/At,动词用 -ing 形式(On entering …)。
美式:store(英式 shop)、salesclerk(英式 shop assistant)、dollars(英式 pounds)、grayish(英式 greyish)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why did Harry decide to give up his little game?
options: The joke product he asked for turned out to be real and cost him money
He was caught by a clerk
He ran out of fake names

passage: My cousin Harry keeps a large, curiously shaped bottle on permanent display in his study. Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green, an observant visitor would soon notice that it is filled with what looks like a thick, grayish substance. If you were to ask Harry what was in the bottle, he would tell you that it contained perfumed mud. If you expressed doubt or surprise, he would immediately invite you to smell it and then to rub some into your skin. This brief experiment would dispel any further doubts you might have. The bottle really does contain perfumed mud. How Harry came into the possession of this outlandish stuff makes an interesting story, which he is fond of telling. What's more, the acquisition of this bottle cured him of a bad habit he had been developing for years. Harry used to consider it a great joke to walk into expensive cosmetic stores and make outrageous requests for goods that do not exist. He would invent fanciful names on the spot. On entering a store, he would ask for a new perfume called 'Scented Shadow' or for 'insoluble bath cubes.' If a salesclerk told him she had never heard of it, he would pretend to be considerably put out. He loved to be told that one of his imaginary products was temporarily out of stock, and he would faithfully promise to come back at some future date — but of course he never did. How Harry managed to keep a straight face during these performances is quite beyond me. Harry does not need to be prompted to explain how he bought his precious bottle of mud. One day, he walked into an exclusive store downtown and asked for 'Myrolite.' The salesclerk looked puzzled, and Harry repeated the word, slowly stressing each syllable. When the woman shook her head in bewilderment, Harry went on to explain that 'myrolite' was a hard, amber-like substance that could be used to remove freckles. This explanation evidently meant something to the woman, who searched shelf after shelf. She produced all sorts of weird concoctions, but none of them met Harry's requirements. When Harry put on his act of being mildly annoyed, the clerk promised to order some for him. Intoxicated by his success, Harry then asked for perfumed mud. He expected the clerk to look at him in blank astonishment. However, it was his turn to be surprised, for the woman's eyes immediately lit up and she fetched several bottles, which she placed on the counter for Harry to inspect. For once, Harry had to admit defeat. He picked up what seemed to be the smallest bottle and discreetly asked the price. He was glad to get away with a mere twenty dollars, and he beat a hasty retreat, clutching the precious bottle under his arm. From then on, Harry decided that this little game he had invented might prove to be expensive. The curious bottle, which now adorns the bookcase in his study, was his first and last purchase of rare cosmetics.

grammar_points.name: 虚拟 were to do / would 表过去反复的习惯
固定搭配 cure sb of / out of stock / keep a straight face
consider/find/think it + 名词/形容词 + to do
被动不定式 to be told / to be surprised / 过去分词状语

stage5.stem: "If you ___ to ask Harry, he would say it was perfumed mud."(虚拟对将来的假设:If + 主语 + ___ + to do)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果你去问哈里,他会说那是香水泥。

stage5.stem: "If you expressed surprise, he ___ invite you to smell it."(条件句主句,填情态动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果你表示惊讶,他会请你闻一闻。

stage5.stem: "Whenever he entered a store, he ___ invent a fancy name."(表过去反复的习惯,填这个助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 每次进店,他都会当场编个花哨的名字。

stage5.stem: "___ entering a store, he would ask for a fake perfume."(“一…就…”,___ + 动名词,填介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一进店,他就会索要一种假香水。

stage5.stem: "On ___ that the product existed, Harry was speechless."(On + ___:一…就,填动名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一听说那产品真有,哈里说不出话来。

stage5.stem: "On ___ home, he put the bottle on his shelf."(On + 动名词:一到家就)
stage5.stem_cn: 一到家,他就把瓶子摆上了架子。

stage5.stem: "He was cured ___ his bad habit by this experience."(cure sb ___ sth:治好某人的…,填介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这次经历治好了他的坏习惯。

stage5.stem: "One product was temporarily out ___ stock."(out ___ stock:脱销,填介词)
"Harry could always keep a straight ___ during the prank."(keep a straight ___:板着脸,填名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 恶作剧时哈里总能板着脸。

stage5.stem: "Harry considered ___ a great joke to fool the clerks."(consider ___ + 名词 + to do:认为…是…,填形式词)
stage5.stem_cn: 哈里认为捉弄店员是件大乐事。

stage5.stem: "He found ___ hard to keep a straight face."(find ___ + 形容词 + to do,填形式词)
"Harry thought ___ funny to invent silly product names."(think ___ + 形容词 + to do)
stage5.stem_cn: 哈里觉得编傻乎乎的产品名很好玩。

stage5.stem: "He loved to be ___ that a product was out of stock."(love to be + 过去分词:喜欢被…,填过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他就爱听说某产品脱销。

stage5.stem: "It was now his turn ___ surprised."(“轮到他被…”,turn ___ surprised,填被动不定式)
"___ by his success, Harry asked for perfumed mud."(过去分词短语作状语:被…冲昏头脑)
stage5.stem_cn: 被成功冲昏头脑,哈里又要起了香水泥。

stage5.stem: "Something very strange and unfamiliar is ___."(“稀奇古怪的”用哪个词)
"To drive away doubts or fears is to ___ them."(“驱散、消除”用哪个词)
"A strange mixture of things stirred together is a ___."(“调制品、混合物”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 七拼八凑调制出的混合物。
